Name: TID_MISSION_0_1_OBJECTIVE
Text: Look, I feel bad asking you to do this when you just escaped with your life, but I need you to pick up something for me. Three canisters of gas. Believe me, it's important.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_1_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks a lot! You know, we don't actually have a working vehicle around here, but there are other uses for this stuff - if you know what I mean...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_100_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, prisoner. Pick up your new clothes and put them on.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_100_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Now, move to the next area. And welcome to the Dawnbreak Prison.\n\nWe give some special treatment to people like you down here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_101_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice. That dude can be helpful.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_102_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, prisoner. Pick up your new clothes and put them on.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_102_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Now, move to the next area. And welcome to the Dawnbreak Prison.\n\nWe give some special treatment to people like you down here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_103_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, prisoner. Pick up your new clothes and put them on.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_103_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Now, move to the next area. And welcome to the Dawnbreak Prison.\n\nWe give some special treatment to people like you down here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_104_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, you! Even in prison break there is safety in numbers.\n\nA mercenary called Pretty Roger wants to get out. Hire him and you can help each other.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_104_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Cool! You have got Pretty Roger with you. What a nice couple you two make.\n\nSend me a postcard when you get out of here. Haha!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_105_OBJECTIVE
Text: You're going to need the backup. Grim Gonzales, a badass bounty hunter, is hunting for escaped prisoners!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_105_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Lloyd's mech broke down? Why am I not surprised...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_105_TALK_TASK_0
Text: I will lead you to GRIM GONZALES!\n\nFollow me!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_106_OBJECTIVE
Text: With all the confusion, now's your chance to escape. Go South and find a Lloyd. He's our resident genius.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_106_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What is this thing, you ask? Well, it's a big bipedal robot, anyone should be able to see that. Now, you have to lead it to McFly before we're run over by Labycore!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_107_OBJECTIVE
Text: First, let's find out what work you're best suited for!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_107_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yes! Finally a good candidate. I'm assigning you to Security. You wouldn't believe the kind of scum we get around here!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_108_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Officer Smith for the final evaluation.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_108_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good day, <PLAYER_NAME>! As a final test of your skills and right mentality, you need to show us that you're prepared to defend Labycore against all security threats.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_109_OBJECTIVE
Text: Your combat training is about to begin! First, pick up a gun and then take out the live targets.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_109_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Congratulations, you passed the evaluation! All that remains is the standard LOBOTOMY OPERATION for Labycore Troopers.\n\nGet in the van, recruit!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_11_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will stay back and guard the door. You go ahead and use the terminal to contact the Resistance.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_11_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text:
[connecting 75.101.155.61...]
[connection ready]

> ... Hello? Verna sent you? So that means you are ready to bust out of the joint?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_110_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need to push our advantage. Go to the field hospital and tell Comandante Jarden what's going on here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_110_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: De La Vega is safe? Good.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_111_OBJECTIVE
Text: I've salvaged the control firmware from one of the drones. Maybe the Resistance could use it to develop an anti-drone virus? With all the reinforcements LabySec keeps bringing in, I can't get it to Duke. Can you do it?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_111_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Scarface tells me this is important stuff. I'll be sure to pass it along.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_112_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Hired Guns patrols in this area are really heavily armed. I'm tired of hiding in this corner and expecting a rocket in the face. Take out their grenadiers and rocketeers!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_112_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Dillinger: I can't hear any more explosions, so I guess you managed to take out all of the heavies. I'm sending your reward right now!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_113_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Duke: Find \qDillinger\q, our contact here. He'll tell you what to do next.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_113_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So you're the new blood Duke sent. Ready for the meat grinder?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_114_OBJECTIVE
Text: You know De La Vega of the 13 Diablos, right? His gang has moved here to support our attack on the power plant. Want to go say hi?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_115_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Mack. He'll know what to do.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_116_OBJECTIVE
Text: We're going to storm Bromden Park and wipe out the screen of Hired Guns defending the Asylum. Julia has scouted the area and is waiting behind the enemy lines.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_116_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You rolled them. Keep the momentum going! I'll organize a perimeter here and keep enemy reinforcements from getting through.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_117_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Robert. He's setting up the big attack on power plant, and keeps asking for reinforcements. Guy is jumpy as hell, he would never make it undercover!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_117_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great to see you! We need all the hands we can get for this one.\n\nThe plan is simple: we fight our way to the gate, while one of us sneaks through a tunnel under the walls and opens up the gate inside.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_118_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Kinder and make sure she's ok. Collect the shipment of Terrordrone parts, make sure you get all of them!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_118_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Just put them right there, I don't want to look inside. I'm glad Kinder is ok. We'll have to extract her soon.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_118_TALK_TASK_0
Text: You have no idea what's going on, do you? It's like that TV show Lost from a few decades back.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_119_OBJECTIVE
Text: I can tell you're new to this fighting business. Don't worry, most of us are, but we share what we know and get better. Curtis over there can show you a move or two.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_119_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Remember to use your skills whenever you can. Keep them sharp and your opponents on their toes.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_120_OBJECTIVE
Text: I've a wide variety of items to sell like all the vendors in Dawnbreak. I'll also buy all the stuff you want to sell. How about buying something from me?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_120_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for shopping!\n\nBy the way. You can expand your inventory by pressing the green plus icon in inventory screen.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_121_OBJECTIVE
Text: Help us! A guard is beating my friend to death, asking him questions he has no answers to!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_121_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: My friend is dead?! Noooo! Damn you Labycore and Sid Lovens, you lying bastard!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_122_OBJECTIVE
Text: Help us! A guard is beating my friend to death, asking him questions he has no answers to!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_122_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: My friend is dead?! Noooo! Damn you Labycore and Sid Lovens, you lying bastard!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_13_OBJECTIVE
Text: I can't go on, leave me and keep moving. Murphy already made it out to the yard, try to catch up!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_13_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You'll need a gun to bust out. Take these plans and there should be enough working parts in this heap of junk to assemble a working rifle.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_14_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We're finally ready to bust this joint? About time. Imagine if you'd arrived a couple of days from now? You'd be stuck here. Talk about good timing. You lucky sonovagun.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_15_OBJECTIVE
Text: Tell Theodore to prepare for jailbreak.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_15_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: The jailbreak is about to happen? Righteous! I'll spread the word.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_18_OBJECTIVE
Text: Follow the road and get deeper into the woods. Find our squad leader Lemmy.\n\nSurprisingly easy here. Calm before the storm, eh?... Have you heard the expression?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_18_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I'm Lemmy. We talked earlier over the hacked terminal. Good to see you made it out in one piece!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_19_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Labycore will be after you any moment now! Your best bet is to head for Pirate Bay. Our guys will help you along the way.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_19_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great, another one made it out! I just got the Mech started, so you're going to have some great backup.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_2_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Lemmy Colorado in Pipe Square.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_2_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hello there. By looking at your scratches, you seem to have had a Warm Welcome... Still, better to break out of jail than surrender to Labycore's 'due process', eh?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_27_OBJECTIVE
Text: There's a comm console in the guards' break room. You could use it to send them on a wild goose chase. Then if you cut power to the local network, they won't be able to receive new orders. After that, talk to Stan who's posted at the gate.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_27_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job, the whole prison security has gone haywire.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_29_FINISHED_SOCIAL_NETWORK_POST
Text: Big mean 'Grim' Gonzales was a bad, bad boy, until he was expertly gibbed by yours truly. Booyah.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_29_OBJECTIVE
Text: The local gang leader 'Grim' Gonzales is holed up in that building. If you can get enough firepower together, you could take him out and throw his gang into complete chaos.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_29_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job taking out Gonzales, <PLAYER_NAME>. The Resistance won't forget it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_3_OBJECTIVE
Text: First we need to immobilize Labycore search teams. Their garage is just nearby - take out their vehicles!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_3_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice work. That should buy us some time.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_36_OBJECTIVE
Text: We have help on the outside. Mason will blow a hole in the wall when he hears us coming. Shoot some guards, make some noise!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_36_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Come on! I'll help as many as I can get away!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_39_OBJECTIVE
Text: Yeah, we're growing Mean Weed here. What you see outside is all we got right now after we lost a couple of harvests. If we lose this one too, I'm as good as dead. I don't mind if you steal it or burn it or whatever, but you gotta protect me, ok?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_39_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So we got a turncoat Mad Dog? I'll tell him where to stick his green thumb. Good job torching the field, we'll put beautiful pavement on there in no time.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_4_OBJECTIVE
Text: The gang running this farm work as cheap muscle for Labycore. They also grow some crops of their own. The best way to distract them is to set their precious weed ablaze.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_4_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Heh, I can see the flames from all the way here. That should keep the bangers busy for a while.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_41_OBJECTIVE
Text: Getting rid of the weed was a good start, but we need to make sure the Dogs don't just come back with a new bag of seeds. If we sabotage their tractors, they'll be out of the growing business for a while.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_41_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That oughta do it. I've dealt with the Mad Dogs and their kind of scum before. A little setback and they give up. It takes a lot more to break us Dockers!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_42_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Harbor belongs to us now, baby! Go tell Holden, and remind him of the bonus I earned with this.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_42_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good work out there. Whatever Rubert says, the fight isn't over yet. We took the ground but now we have to hold it. You'll lend us a hand, won't you?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_44_OBJECTIVE
Text: Follow Freddie to the next room and deal with possible problems.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_44_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You cannot save me but save yourself! Get out through that fire exit at the back of the room! Run!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_45_OBJECTIVE
Text: Enter the Immigration Office and talk to your friends.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_45_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: May I see your ID, please? We need to register your information into the system.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_46_OBJECTIVE
Text: Take the elevator downstairs by clicking the green arrow on the floor, and talk to Officer Smith.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_46_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text:
(Smith eyes you from head to toe. He is itching to give you a beating.)

It seems that you've been living two lives, <PLAYER_NAME>. One of these lives has a future, whereas the other...
Please move next to your friend there and wait for your turn.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_5_OBJECTIVE
Text: I just found out that Labycore Security has captured another escapee, and they're roughing her up while waiting for pickup. Help her get back here!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_5_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We're in this together, everyone helping each other. That's why I believe in the Resistance.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_50_OBJECTIVE
Text: Here, take this kerosene and burn down the warehouse in Export Area. Don't worry, it's empty... except for the Mobsters that stole everything I owned. Do this and I'll tell you what you want to know.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_50_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ok, here's the deal. The coupons look real enough, but without the unique DNA imprint of a Dawnbreak citizen on each one, they're completely useless to you.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_51_OBJECTIVE
Text: Sure, I can help you. There's one Dawnbreak citizen around these parts. Bobby Boy seems to think he can get away with with any crime because he's a citizen. You want his DNA? Go spill some blood.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_51_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Well, that's enough for one purchase. But you can't just smear blood on the coupon, you know!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_52
Text: A Dog As Courier? How Stupid Is That?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_52_OBJECTIVE
Text: Plant a bomb on the Mad Dog courier's car in Crane area.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_52_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ah, I love the smell of burning gasoline in the morning.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_53_OBJECTIVE
Text: We're going to take over the water reservoirs. Let the Hired Guns feel real thirst for a change.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_54_OBJECTIVE
Text: Free Angelina's sister and escort her to the submarine.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_54_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you a thousand times!\nNow me and my sister can finally leave this nightmare behind!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_56_OBJECTIVE
Text: One of our girls, Zoe was trying to spring some newcomers when she got herself caught. Free her and she'll make it worth your while!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_56_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Would you mind helping me? I'm not really into this bondage stuff.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_57_OBJECTIVE
Text: Still here? I guess you're looking for a different kind of action. Here's a big one: take out Madame Kruschok in the nearby Queens cathouse. If you can also get your hands on her client list, we could do some real mischief.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_57_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Wow, you're pretty amazing. You can hook up your brain to the net while splattering other people's brains all over the place. I'd give you a kiss but cyber implants give me the creeps, and the blood ain't helping either.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_58_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy the Water Pump and escort Saffron to safety in Mud Beach North.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_58_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I hear the mission went like clockwork. Well done!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_59_OBJECTIVE
Text: Travel to Abyssos Eastern Entrance and clear out all Hooligans from the area.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_59_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Cheers! Now the regulars can come here in peace, and end their hard day in our soothing arms like they want to.\nHuh. I got a sudden yearning for a banana.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_6_OBJECTIVE
Text: Retrieve the Gasoline canister from the Truck Dock.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_6_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Excellent! Time to get the show on the road.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_60_OBJECTIVE
Text: This is it. Those fascist dogs are outside. Kill every man and beast!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_60_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I'm glad you're safe! Those monsters deserved to die. The poor girls are almost dead from exposure and starvation, and too weak to be moved right now. I'll get them some food and drink first of all.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_61_OBJECTIVE
Text: Burn Drill Master Morty's cars in Drill Facility Entrance.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_62_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Insert access card to unlock water reservoir

Name: TID_MISSION_0_63_OBJECTIVE
Text: The mercs know they're beaten, and might do something desperate. Mop up any Hired Guns stragglers before they damage the water system.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_63_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That was some serious ass whooping we gave them!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_64
Text: If You Have a Plan, Stick to It

Name: TID_MISSION_0_64_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Mal's Plans from the Mad Dog Repair Man in the Dry Dock.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_64_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Right on! These plans are very important to us in curbing the W.U.Z.Z. pushing in the area.\nDid I say thanks yet?\nI guess I will, at some point.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_65_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Share of the profits? Now now, remember that you're doing a valuable, unselfish service to the community.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_66_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Missing Friend in Cargo Warehouse. Recover W.U.Z.Z. packages for disposal.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_66_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh. Oh no. They made an addict out of her? Oh, son of a--!\nI better tell Kaylee. We'll do what we can to detox her. It's a real shame you can't kill the monsters twice.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_67_OBJECTIVE
Text: Escort the 13 Diablos member and disable three transformer boxes.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_67_TALK_TASK_0
Text: You can count on me! I'll watch your back, and you'll watch mine, right!\nI'll lead the way and you'll take out the electricity. Let's move out!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_68_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Hired Guns are still holed up in the Water Purification Plant. We can't risk having them at the water source, they might get desperate and poison the water or break the purification systems. Clear them out!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_68_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That was one tough bitch. I didn't know the Guns had high level assassins working for them. I'm amazed you took her out, kudos!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_69_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find and talk to the Docker scout in Western Junkyard.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_69_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Holy Mary, the Mother of God! Serial killers wearing suits, and Mad Dogs feeding people to the pigs we eat! I can never eat bacon again! Those sick maniacs will pay for ruining my favorite food group!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_7_OBJECTIVE
Text: I'm going to stay here to help more prisoners get out. You should head West until you get to Needlewood, then look up Lloyd Brown. You got that? Now go!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_7_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: No time to talk! Labycore are closing in, and I need to concentrate!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_70_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: Kill chief engineer Shock Dave in Southern Power Plant.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_70_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: Nice job! Skilled workers are hard to find, and not many want to work for Labycore when we keep picking off their pros.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_71_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Input pump ID numbers for rerouting low-pressure maintenance flow

Name: TID_MISSION_0_72_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Raiders walked off with the most precious cargo from the truck, guns and medical supplies. I'll give you a good bounty for both.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_72_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job, we can't afford to lose any of these supplies.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_73_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: I told Ricky of the Diablos about the back way into Power Plant, and he went all gung ho. The guy's eager but there's no way he'll survive alone. Get him out of there!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_73_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: He'd better count his lucky stars, it's a miracle he's still breathing. Good job, <PLAYER_NAME>. I bet the Diablos will want to show their gratitude.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_74_OBJECTIVE
Text: Thanks honey! Now I can get back to rescuing those girls. You want to see them safe, don't you? Follow me and do your thing!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_74_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Look at these poor things, half starved and with hardly a thread to cover them. Let's go back to the Casino Royale and we'll take good care of you all. Especially you, <PLAYER_NAME>!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_76_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go talk to Alton at the Northern Warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_76_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hi, mate! Looking for work? Well, you came to the right man. Just come and talk to me again whenever you need something to do.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_77_OBJECTIVE
Text: Raid the drug lab in Export Area. Kill Mad Boss, and get a pure W.U.Z.Z. sample.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_77_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Excellent work! With Mad Boss dead, and this pure sample of W.U.Z.Z., we're one step closer to freeing the city of the drug's influence.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_78
Text: I'm Afraid I Was Very, Very Drunk!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_78_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kill Mobile Weapons Platform, download research files, and recover personnel files in Dawnbreak City Harbor.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_78_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job! I knew I could count on you! The Resistance is in your debt, <PLAYER_NAME>.\nI'd buy you a stiff drink to celebrate your success, but to be honest, the mere thought of alcohol makes me nauseous.\nI will never again this much, that's a promise.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_79_OBJECTIVE
Text: Head to the Barracks and locate the 13 Diablos strike team. They're walking straight into a trap, tell them to abort mission immediately!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_79_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We got bushwacked good and proper, and two of our members are dead...\nStill, thanks, <PLAYER_NAME>. You still managed to save one of our finest.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_79_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Thanks for showing up to save my ass. The others are dead. How did they even catch us?! It was like they knew exactly where we were and what we were going to do.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_80_OBJECTIVE
Text: Shut the power from Brick Top Piggery by destroying three transformer boxes.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_80_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That pig farm gives me the creeps. No one actually knows what is going on there. Why keep swine in a place like that?\nAh, never mind. All that really matters is that the power is now out. Good job.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_81_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: We found out from a source that Security Troopers in the Power Plant North district just received a shipment of weapons. Unfortunately, we weren't able to intercept the shipment, but it's not too late to grab those guns.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_81_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: We're outgunned against Labycore, but heists like this go a long way towards evening the odds.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_82_OBJECTIVE
Text: Club Flesh protects their inhuman activities with high security. Cripple their systems by destroying the main power coupling in Abyssos Offices.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_82_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Solid work, <PLAYER_NAME>!\nNow we'll just wait for their backup generators to run out, and then us and them, we'll have a nice get together.\nFeel free to join us, if you want.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_83_OBJECTIVE
Text: The walk here was rough, ese. I can hardly stand. Get me something to drink and we'll talk.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_84_OBJECTIVE
Text: Get three explosives and kill Sheila

Name: TID_MISSION_0_84_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That bitch won't be missed. Good work.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_85_OBJECTIVE
Text: Look, I can help you cash in those coupons, but first I need you to do something for me. I left a package in a nearby warehouse, where some punks have now moved in. Go fetch it, will you?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_85_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It's like Xmas! And this year, Santa brought kerosene to good little children.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_86_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go talk to Neil in the weapon shop in Northern Warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_86_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hah. Men and their toys. I almost thought that the Hooligans had held up the shop or something. But nooooo, it's just boys being boys. Sheesh.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_87_OBJECTIVE
Text: Plant a bug in the Labycore warehouse in Southern Warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_87_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Heh. Smooth. Now all we gotta do is tune in, an' we'll find out what Labycore wants their favorite lapdogs, the Mad Dogs, to do. Easy, an' oddly satisfying.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_88_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need a faster way to bring in munitions to support our attack on the Power Plant. There's a helipad to the south, but the bridge leading there is closed off. Hack into the Labycore transport system to get the gate codes.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_88_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Duke: Good job! They won't be able to close the gate again without calling in a technician. Now we can take over the helipad.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_89_OBJECTIVE
Text: Shut down the communications mainframe on the Western Power Plant yard, and then eliminate Chief Engineer Zegor.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_89_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You truly are a hero! The citizens of Dawnbreak Isle owe you their thanks.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_9_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Hyman in Rebel Camp.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_9_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Welcome to the outskirts of Dawnbreak City. Labycore does not have a lot of presence here but their gangs unfortunately do.\nThis is one of the biggest Resistance bases on Dawnbreak Isle. The base may not look like much, but it packs more punch than you'd think.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_0_91_OBJECTIVE
Text: Meet Curtis the skill trainer in Southern Warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_91_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: There you go! Learning and using skills is just as important as having good weapons and equipment.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_92_OBJECTIVE
Text: Save Amador and eliminate the Sewer Voodoo leader, Akirun.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_92_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hooray! Me man is safe! And it's all thanks to you! We'll give you a discount in our shop, yessir we will!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_92_TALK_TASK_1
Text: Please help me! The Voodoos leader Akirun locked me in here!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_93_OBJECTIVE
Text: Escort Nilda and help her steal some 'super gas'.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_93_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good work. If this super gas is the real deal, it shouldn't take us that long to manufacture some of our own.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_93_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Are you a friend of Ramon? Good. There are some tough looking guys patrolling the place. And be on the lookout for snipers. And watch where you step. And be quiet.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_94_OBJECTIVE
Text: Break five crates lying on the road in Northern Warehouse

Name: TID_MISSION_0_94_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Fine job you did there. Fine job. Not that smashing some crates is *that* hard, but fine job nonetheless!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_95_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy Prototype Spiderbot and download blueprints for the bot in New Moscow Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_95_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? They've already began mass producing the solar power bots? This is bad. Very bad.\nThanks for the blueprints, though - we'll see if we can use them to come up with a more... permanent solution.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_96_OBJECTIVE
Text: Eliminate Club Flesh members in South Park Garden.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_96_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I don't know how much you know about those Club Flesh creeps, but those maniacs deserve nothing less than a painful death filled with suffering and agony. And pain.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_97_OBJECTIVE
Text: Help us! A guard is beating my friend to death, asking him questions he has no answers to!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_97_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: My friend is dead?! Noooo! Damn you Labycore and Sid Lovens, you lying bastard!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_98_OBJECTIVE
Text: After the prison alarm went off, this whole place went into lockdown. To open the gates and escape you need to access the gate controller.\n\nThe path to the gates leads through the woods. Be careful of guard patrols!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_98_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good work. Here, take these grenades.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_99_OBJECTIVE
Text: Welcome to Dawnbreak! Here you'll have a job and a happy, fulfilling life. Guaranteed!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_99_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yes! Finally a good candidate. I'm assigning you to Security. You wouldn't believe the kind of scum we get around here!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_123_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Raiders are the biggest customers of this island's greatest shame, the slave trade. Slaves are made to fight each other in underground pits until they become as cruel as their masters. Put an end to this evil.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_123_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you for stopping Slavemaster. You're truly a hero of Paradise Island.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_124_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our attack on the power plant can only succeed if someone gets inside the compound and opens the gates from there.\n\nThere's something very odd about the tunnel that we discovered. Find out what you can about it!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_124_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: Abyssos Energy & Landscaping? I know Abyssos, they're the shady Labycore subcontractor who built this plant. But what's this about Landscaping?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_125_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: All right, we're in business. First of all, I want you to disable security systems in the Northern sector of the plant.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_125_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: Great job! The security gates are open and we can move to our next objective.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_126_OBJECTIVE
Text: Ok, you've made it far enough that I'm going to confide in you. We're going to destroy the Power Plant, not take it over.\n\nLet's get going. You need to turn off the magnetic field generator in the Northern sector of the plant.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_126_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job. It'll take days to recharge those capacitors... and once we sabotage the plant's cooling, a chain reaction and meltdown is going to be inevitable.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_127_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: Cut power to the plant's cooling. Think of it like lighting a fuse - after you're done, the clock will be ticking. Are you ready for this?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_127_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: All right. If you have any reservations about what we're doing, forget about them. There's no going back now.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_127_TASK_0
Text: Turn off power to Power Plant cooling

Name: TID_MISSION_0_128_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: We need to make sure that the cooling systems don't get back online. Take out the maintenance supervisor! I doubt the regular service guys will risk their lives for the power plant.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_128_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: I know it was a dirty job, but someone had to do it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_129_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: According to our information, the head of Abyssos Research is in the plant right now. He is a secondary target, but an important one. Take him out if you can!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_129_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: Good job! This will slow down their R&D considerably.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_130_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: Here's a target of opportunity. Abyssos has been conducting research on a new type of fuel cell inside the plant facilities. Steal their research if you run across it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_130_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: Fantastic job! Now we'll know what capabilities to expect from Labycore's vehicles. Even better, our own R&D will get a huge boost.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_131_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: It's time to hit the switch and make this facility fry itself. You ready?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_131_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Well done! Now, there's not much time. The radiation in this area will rise to hazardous levels any moment now. Finish what you're doing and get on the boat.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_132_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Robert: Relay these orders to the strike team. Hurry up!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_132_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Okay, we have our orders. Time to move again.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_133_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, listen up! We need to clear this area, destroy the command & control bot and set up a beachhead. This is a once in a lifetime opportunity, let's not waste it. Give them hell!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_133_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Robert: You made it! Fantastic work.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_134_OBJECTIVE
Text: We've done a fair deal of tunneling to prepare for the big attack on the power plant. That Robert sure likes excavations!\n\nNow, we can't get our guys to enter the dig anymore. Go show them that they're pussies for being afraid of the dark!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_134_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Formigas? No wonder our guys were afraid. Thanks for a fine extermination job, <PLAYER_NAME>.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_135_OBJECTIVE
Text: The guys are refusing to dig again. It seems there are \qhulking shadows\q down there. Show them what spineless cowards they are!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_135_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What, muties? I was expecting more Formigas. When and where did those mutant monstrosities get into our tunnels?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_136_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, this is getting ridiculous. Still no work being done here, this time the spineless cowards are talking about some \qslithering terror\q.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_136_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You have got to be kidding me. Ants, mutants and now lizards? Where do these creatures spawn from?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_137_OBJECTIVE
Text: Now follow the road and find Rachel. She should be posted somewhere along the supply road.\n\nWatch out for troopers!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_138_OBJECTIVE
Text:
See the cage on the right? Get your hands on those bazooka rockets and hunted becomes the hunter!

Gates will open if you have enough Credibility to fool the camera AI. Credibility can be gained in two ways:
1) Have friends as mercenaries OR
2) Wear items with Credibility bonus. Click SHOP to browse for PREMIUM CLOTHES.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_138_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You got them! Excellent work!\n\nWith this launcher they become usable. Have fun!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_139_OBJECTIVE
Text: That Grim Gonzales is a fearsome dude, but his mighty beard is also his greatest weakness. Imagine what would happen if it caught on fire?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_139_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Alright, I'll just add some gasoline and... a rag. Those will burn like crazy!\n\nHey, you have a crafting bot! That means we can make some grenades too.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_140_OBJECTIVE
Text: You met Pretty Roger in the prison, right? He's scouting up ahead. Call him when you're ready to fight Gonzales.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_140_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You took out Grim Gonzales!? Wow!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_141_OBJECTIVE
Text: I doubt you can face Grim Gonzales by yourself, no matter how many Grenades and Molotovs you toss at him. I saw another fugitive running around looking for help, get him on-board!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_141_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: All right, the stage is set. <PLAYER_NAME>, are you ready?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_142_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, new guy! You got great timing, we're about to bust out of here. Make a weapon so you can fight with us.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_142_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great. Just swing that and smash any guards you see! You go ahead, I'll see you on the other side.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_143_OBJECTIVE
Text: You need to craft yourself a decent gun! You seem to have plans for Custom Rifle. That'll do it just fine!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_143_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Looks good! You've got the knack, I can tell. Soon you'll be crafting armor and high-tech gadgets!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_144_OBJECTIVE
Text: With all these parts from dead Search Bugs lying around, you can craft an explosive surprise for Gonzales.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_144_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: All right, a grenade! When you see Grim, just pull the pin and throw. Easy as A, B, C!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_145_OBJECTIVE
Text: My twin-brother Roger is a local mercenary who helps unlucky immigrants to get away from Labycore's hands. Hire him and get out of here before it's too late!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_145_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great! Get these plans for custom made rifle.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_146_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need to have that gate open. Go to that building and access the gate controller while I will contact my partner.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_146_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You are quite a soldier, aren't you!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_147_OBJECTIVE
Text: I hear Grim Gonzales is in Needlewood! You'll have to get past him to reach Pirate Bay.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_147_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Lloyd's mech broke down? Why am I not surprised...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_147_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Grim Gonzales is right up ahead.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_148_OBJECTIVE
Text: Fire is a great way to deal with a rioting crowd. Take down the targets and move to the exit.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_148_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Congratulations, you passed the evaluation! All that remains is the standard LOBOTOMY OPERATION for Labycore Troopers.\n\nGet in the van, recruit!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_149_OBJECTIVE
Text: I have a proposal for you. Start working for us and we will reward you with resources and equipment. Only together we can take down Labycore and their allies!\nMake yourself home and get to know my crew.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_149_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good to have more people to join us. I have a perfect case to test your co-operative skills.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_150_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hi mate. So you are willing to help us? Our trader, Javier, is in trouble with Labycore customs. He's right there in the next block.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_150_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Vladek told me that he would be sending someone to handle the Labycore scum and here you are! Great!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_151_OBJECTIVE
Text: I've been hunting these demons of sin for about two years now. They were created in some sick experiment. Only cake or human blood will satisfy them, and we're all out of cake!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_151_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you, warrior of Dawnbreak. With the Sin Demons gone, we can have cake and chocolate milk to celebrate!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_152_OBJECTIVE
Text: The... evil creator of... the creatures... he's down there. I almost got him but... *gasp* chimera!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_152_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Well done! Now, are you absolutely sure you got the right Emmett?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_153_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hi, <PLAYER_NAME>! This room is for special guests like you. It's our way to thank you for helping us build Dawnbreak. Visit here for unique content only for beta participants!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_153_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Wear this hat proudly to show you were in Gunshine Beta. Come back soon to get access to awesome missions, boss fights and loot!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_154_OBJECTIVE
Text: Did you see the news? Huge explosion on Labycore Anatomical Research and Production Unit (A.R.P.U) No one knows what's happened there. Could you take a look?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_154_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for coming! I'm a Dawnbreak Independent reporter, but I'm too tired to move.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_154
Text: I did see that on news.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_155_OBJECTIVE
Text: I did hear some growling noises coming from the forest. Could you take a look? There could be people lost in the woods.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_155_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This place is full of death...Everybody is dead.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_156_OBJECTIVE
Text: I'm keeping a stand here if some survivors shows up. I have meds and food for them. My friend Shane went to that bridge to look for some supplies. Can you run after him?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_156_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It's a dead end...you don't wanna go there. It's a terrible place. Maybe we can find help from L.A.R.P.U.?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_157_OBJECTIVE
Text: Could you go and take a look at that exploded L.A.R.P.U. factory? There might be some survivors there who need help.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_157_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? Undead zombies? We are doomed!! We have to warn the citizens. I'm writing a story about this.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_158_OBJECTIVE
Text: You heard that we're buying fuel? That's right, we'll pay $100 for a gallon. Let me know if you find any, and I'll buy it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_158_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yes, this will make them burn. Now there's no reason to have that look on your face, we're building a zombie trap here. That's what the gasolin is for.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_159_OBJECTIVE
Text: That fuel thing went allright, didn't it? Maybe you would also be interested in finding us parts for a detonator? Let me know if you find something we can use.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_160_OBJECTIVE
Text: Bob, our chief mechanic, also went searching for the detonator parts and he hasn't come back. We have to find him asap. Are you up for another trip outside?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_160_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You saved my as... brains! Zombies are everywhere!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_161_OBJECTIVE
Text: I need brains. braaains.. braaaainss... Just kidding, we need brains for the zombie trap, that is the bait. This hospital was about to receive an organ donation shipment just before they shut down the place. See if you can find it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_161_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Awesome, those organ transportation boxes were zombie-proof!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_162_OBJECTIVE
Text: It'll take me a while to assemble the Zombie trap. I call it the Bobinator. Cool, huh? Err.. what I was about to say, is that you should talk to Zeela, it's something about a shotgun.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_162_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good that you found me. Bob the builder said that you are good at finding things. (We call him that behind his back. He's really our Chief Mechanic.)

Name: TID_MISSION_0_163_OBJECTIVE
Text: I'm willing to pay a fortune for this epic Headshot Shotgun I keep hearing about. They say it's made by some ex-military fellow who's got a stronghold somewhere around here. Bring that shotgun to me and I'll give you $500 for it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_163_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Geee, thanks! I mean really, this is awesome! The best weapon I've ever had. If only I could meet it's maker some day.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_164_OBJECTIVE
Text: Bob asked me to pass you this message: \qThe Bobinator is ready!\q He said that you would know what that means, so maybe you should talk to him.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_164_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great to see you! This is a big day, big day indeed!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_164_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Bob the chief mechanic

Name: TID_MISSION_0_165_OBJECTIVE
Text: Dawnbreak's greates zombie trap, The Bobinator, is finally finished and ready for deployment. Would you like to have the honor of planting it? I have to warn you, Michelle Kneiffer told me that 5 huge zombies were spotted outside.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_165_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It's all set? Good! One more thing...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_166_OBJECTIVE
Text: One more thing. I need to genereta some power to the The Bobinators. There is a emergency generator on downstairs. Could you go fire it up.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_167_OBJECTIVE
Text: Once again, thank you so much! Before you go, Zeela wanted to talk to you.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_167_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great, Michelle told you that I was looking for you! Oh her name sounds familiar? Well according to what I have heard, she used to be a gang member, not an actress.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_168_OBJECTIVE
Text: I heard that we are all secured here now and that doesn't give me too many opportunities to try out my new shotgun. I decided to go to Old World Hotel and see if I can find some action along the way. I could use some company, care to join me?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_168_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Here we are. And it's looking bad. Great, huh?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_168
Text: Places to see, zombies to kill

Name: TID_MISSION_0_169_OBJECTIVE
Text: I think I'm going to stay here for a while, this looks like a good, zombie infested spot. You should go and see if that hotel still has people in it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_169_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hello there, I'm Amsterdam. Great to see another survivor!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_170_OBJECTIVE
Text: Did you see anyone on your way here? A girl named Paris? She left two days ago and took with her the only key to the hotel's walk-in refrigerator. I'm getting really hungry, so can you go and get her, or at least the key?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_170_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: (Note on the dead girl says: Amsterdam, if you're reading this: haa-haa! I'm finished and so are you, have fun starving to death.)

Name: TID_MISSION_0_170_TASK_0
Text: Find Paris and retrieve the key

Name: TID_MISSION_0_171_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We are saved! You found the key, you are awesome!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_172_OBJECTIVE
Text: By the way, I saw someone running by the window while you were out, she had a huge shotgun in her hand and she was whistling some hunting tune. You know her? Well, go get her, We could use someone like that!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_172_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Inside, you say... A walk-in refrigerator with enough ingredients for hundreds of hotel breakfasts, you say?! Sure thing. First I like to shoot more of thease undeads!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_173_OBJECTIVE
Text: Errr. Now that we have so much people here, we are consuming astronomical amounts of propaine to cook all that food and keep that hotel generator going.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_173_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You found these outside the hotel, and there were more? That's great news!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_174_OBJECTIVE
Text: There must be someone hiding in upstairs, because I have heard voices from there. I mean real voices, not just some gurgling for brains. I would go myself, but I'm kind of between meals here... Will you check it out? I'll open the door for you.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_174_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I was sure that the zombies were here to get us, me and my little brother Billy and my daddy Franky here. My name is Nora.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_175_OBJECTIVE
Text: It's safe downstairs? I thought that I have been smelling something delicious cooking, but I was sure that it was only my imagination...I'm hurt...I think one of them bit me...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_175_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What a sad case, one of many these days, I'm afraid. I think Nora needs some painkillers...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_176_OBJECTIVE
Text: I don't have any painkillers...but I did see survivor kits near the water when I came here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_176_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What a relief. She has been sleeping ever since you left. With some sleep and these, I'm sure she will get well soon again.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_177_OBJECTIVE
Text: Ahh, finally someone came. We used to have a nice thing going on in here, before all this nasty zombie business started.. But now we've lost all our customers. Find us customers and I'll cut you in on a slice of the profit. What do you say?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_177_TALK_TASK_0
Text: That sound great, a night club without zombies!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_177_TALK_TASK_1
Text: I hate zombies. This is all Labycore's fault.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_177_TALK_TASK_2
Text: You're not a zombie, are you?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_177_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Alright! You found us customers, it's looking really good. Cheers!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_178_OBJECTIVE
Text: People are thirsty! This zombie invasion is the best thing that has ever happened to my business! But now we're running out of liquor.. I heard that there are some drunks bottles full of vodka by the canal, get me those, will you?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_178_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Just in time, we served our last zombie free cocktail a minute ago!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_179_OBJECTIVE
Text: Now that you're here, you should talk to our Bouncer, he had something on his mind.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_179_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Vanilla sent you, our Club manager? I sure hope you can help me.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_180_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our best bartender Kismet didn't arrive at work today, and I'm getting a bit worried. She lives close by, in that tall building by the canal. Will you go and check if she's alright?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_180_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: The Bouncer sent you? To be honest, I could use some help. I've been trapped inside my house cause my boyfriend turned one of them...and invited his friends to party...they give me the creeps

Name: TID_MISSION_0_181_OBJECTIVE
Text: Will you tag along, I'd rather not walk alone. It's a short way there, but still. Anything can happen. You go first, I try to find my gun...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_181_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hey thanks for making sure that Kismet made it here safely.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_181_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Lock and load! Just get me to end of this corridor and I will be fine from there.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_182_OBJECTIVE
Text: After that shooting happend, the murder on the dancefloor as people call it, we have decided to arm our staff to the teeth. I have a contact who can sell us the guns, but I need someone trustworthy to go and buy them.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_182_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yes, it's me, Elvis...The King of Dawnbreak. Auwieee!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_183_OBJECTIVE
Text: A group of police zombies raided our customers and tried to eat their brains. That wont do! Everybody knows that you need to keep your head on your shoulders when you party.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_183_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I'm glad that you're here. Things aren't good.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_184_OBJECTIVE
Text: Sorry. I don't have guns right here. But my fixed guy can take care of this. He lives in New Napples Street

Name: TID_MISSION_0_184_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: If you're interested in weapons, you came to the right place.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_185_OBJECTIVE
Text: You're here to get all those weapons Elvis ordered? I'll have it ready in a minute, so how about doing me a favour in the meantime? I'll pay you for your trouble.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_185_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Sweet mama! You found me guns! Here, you've earned it.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_186_OBJECTIVE
Text: It seems that our weapon shipment to Elvis is ready. Take these to Elvis and tell him that it was a pleasure doing business with him. As always. Oh, and come back after you've delivered them, will you?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_186_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: The guns are here! Let's see if those gangers feel like tyring their luck with us now.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_187_OBJECTIVE
Text: See this helicopter, find spare parts for it and I'll promise to take you with me if we can make it fly.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_187_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hmmm.. This is a good start, yes.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_188_OBJECTIVE
Text: I saw some fuel tanks on that fenced yard. Only problem is, that it's crawling with zombies and who knows what. I wouldn't go there if I were you, but it's your choise.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_188_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You managed to find us fuel! I knew that you could help us.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_189_OBJECTIVE
Text: While you were gone I got yet another order for shovels. I just don't get it, I mean who thinks that a shovel is the best weapon against zombies? I don't say no to a customer, but I'm running out of shovels here. Will you loot that former construction company's warehouse for me?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_189_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? Zombie fight with shovels? This is so wierd...Get this extra shovel for your troubles. It may come handy.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_190_OBJECTIVE
Text: Labycore just dropped piles of junk and I don't think they did out of kindness. Can you go check them out?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_190_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So they were trying to keep us from finding those valves. Funkydory, this is getting spicy! Here, keep up the holy work!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_191_OBJECTIVE
Text: There was a red flare from the shore, right from where Henry's boat is. Can you go see what is the matter with him?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_191_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I thought the zombies had eaten you all! Here, a gift from Hermit Henry. Keep on living, comrade.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_192_OBJECTIVE
Text: My engine is dry. I going to check some old barrels for gas. I need you to keep the stiffs off me. Can you do that?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_192_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks to you I now have a full can of gas. Here is something for your effort. Too bad I can't take you to the city because of the snipers.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_193_OBJECTIVE
Text: I think Labycore wants to wipe us out. I just spotted five kill teams moving into positions around us. You have to take them out, one by one.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_193_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's the spirit! Good for them to live in terror for a while. Here, I've been saving this.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_194_OBJECTIVE
Text: Eddie marked down some points of interest. I sent out a scout and now he is missing. Please, be the Angel of Funk and save him.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_194_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I thought I was done for! Here, this for saving me life. You'll have to escort me back.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_195_OBJECTIVE
Text: My leg is busted so I can't run. Keep those zombies off me until we reach the camp!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_195_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Whew! That was hairy. Here, some loot I picked up in there. You certainly earned this.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_196_OBJECTIVE
Text: My boyfriend got sick after after a zombie bite. Now he ran off to some decomposing \qgirl\q Go teach those zombies a lesson!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_196_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Right, maybe the next zombie who wants to steal my beau will think twice! Here is your reward!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_196_TASK_0
Text: Kill 6 zombies in the name of love

Name: TID_MISSION_0_197_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our meds have stopped working. I think there is a new breed of zombies. Please, can you kill some and bring me some blood samples?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_197_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! We have to find a new cure or it is all over for us. Here, this is from all of us.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_198_OBJECTIVE
Text: Strange, the zombie mutation seems artificial. Can you please take this letter to Nolan West? He is somewhere at Palm beach.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_198_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Well hello there, new face! And what's this? A letter? As you can see...i'm not feeling well.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_199_OBJECTIVE
Text: I did see some filthy zombies on the beach...taking some sun. Could you go and see what the heck they are doing? They smell so bad that I lose my apetite.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_199_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Omigosh! Thanks. I was sure that those zombies would eat me and my friend here.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_200_OBJECTIVE
Text: I have had enough of this zombie madnes. I and Saturday are building raft to get away from this god forsaken place! Could you help us find some wood?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_200_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks mate! You want't to go to city? It's dangerous place. But I think I have solution for you...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_201_OBJECTIVE
Text: You should talk to Mole if you want to get inside of these walls. it might be little safer than outside.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_201_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Newcomer? Follow this road to get to the Dawnbreak...but be aware, It's not safe.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_202_OBJECTIVE
Text: Power switch is down in the subway alright but there is also something else... You need allies to kill the Mutated Zombie Freak that has taken over the place.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_202_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You did it! I don't know if it is enough but we've taken the first step towards saving the island! Here, this is for you.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_203_OBJECTIVE
Text: Some new zombies look fresh. Go east and check the Refugee Camp for survivors. They might even know something about the pumps.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_203_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: A living soul! Welcome to Choir of the Blessed! I am Mister Zee, the Apostle of Funky Redemption! And this is my flock!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_204_OBJECTIVE
Text: You should talk to my man Lloyd. I can open that gate and he can get you to the city

Name: TID_MISSION_0_204_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ok. You want to get to the city. I can helpt you...there are some labycore troopers in the woods.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_205_OBJECTIVE
Text: I was into city and when I did come back....I saw this madness. Zombies are spreading at our village. If you help me to clean this village I can help you. I was doing research about these Zombies on nearby Labycore research center. Could you locate the research data for me?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_205_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? Labycore was doing tests with the Raiders? That's just sick...Glad they get to taste their own medicine.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_206_OBJECTIVE
Text: I have no idea how long those zombies think there is a gate between us. We need to eliminate all those surrounding zombies before they brake in!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_206_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This is so bad...I was helping Labycore to move some gear through this area. Now it's full of Zombies!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_207_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need to use that huge drilling machine to get Labycore research center. I think that's the place where this spread has started.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_207_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You found the keys? Nice one! Now you should really get going before these zombies come back...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_207
Text: Where the Heck are my keys?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_208_OBJECTIVE
Text: I...I'd escaped from that ship...ship of blood. Eastern Queens bring girls to the harbor for sex slaves...I need help... to revenge.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_208_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you stranger...I try to get on my life now in this god forsaken city.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_209_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Dr. Bauhofs Key if you do me a favor and take down Chief Engineer, the final guardian at Power Plant West.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_209_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Dr. Bauhoff. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_210_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Riot Town Key if you do me a favor and take down bosses at New Naples Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_210_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Riot Town. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_211_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Seven Deadly Sins Key if you do me a favor and take down guardians at New Peking Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_211_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Seven Deadly Sins. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_212_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Queen of Diamonds if you do me a favor and take down Queen Bathory, the guardian at Power New Venice Hotel

Name: TID_MISSION_0_212_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Queen of Diamonds. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_213_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Slavemaster if you do me a favor and take down Akirun, the voodoo guardian at East Canal.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_213_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the The Slavemaster. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_214_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Raider Village Key if you do me a favor and take down boss at Desert Storm

Name: TID_MISSION_0_214_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Raider Village. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_215_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Raider Valley Key if you do me a favor and take down bosses at Deserted Village

Name: TID_MISSION_0_215_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Raider Valley. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_216_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Devourer Dragon if you do me a favor and take down guardians at Lovens Park West.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_216_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Devourer Dragon. Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_217_OBJECTIVE
Text: Bulwark: A specialist who is focused on protecting their team members in harder group missions and instances. Generates high threat.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_217_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Bulwark skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_218_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hurricane: Bodyguards with hurricane weapon class can hurt many targets at once with their area damage abilitties.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_218_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Hurricane skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_219_OBJECTIVE
Text: Rampage: A bodyguard with a Rampage weapon focuses on damage dealing rather than protecting their allies.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_219_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yu find rest of the Rampage skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_220_OBJECTIVE
Text: Prolonger: Doctors with Prolonger healing weapons can heal their allies over time. They can also increase group's melee power and energy pool.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_220_RECEIVING_MESSAGE

Name: TID_MISSION_0_221_RECEIVING_MESSAGE

Name: TID_MISSION_0_222_OBJECTIVE
Text: Insta-Healers are effective healers when it comes to healing fast. They posses powerful healing abilitties with high energy cost.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_222_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Insta-Healer skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_223_OBJECTIVE
Text: Leviathan hunters deal damage to multiple targets in an area at once. They also have ability to increas their attack speed for short while.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_223_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Leviathan skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_224_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hunters with Wasp type weapons get acces to deadly poisons and bullets that cripple their enemies.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_224_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Wasp skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_225_OBJECTIVE
Text: A hunter with a Firefly weapon focuses on damage bursts on single target with a bit higher energy cost.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_225_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You find rest of the Firefly skills at shop. Bosses drop special ability weapons.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_226_OBJECTIVE
Text: There has been a zombie outbreak! Labycore is trying to handle the defense and they'll try to stop you too. There are some dangerous prisoners giving 'em trouble and they need to be taken down before they can leave the prison! Could you help us take these guys out?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_226_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you for helping us! Now the prison is clean again so maybe Labycore can re-populate it with resistance members...and I can free them like I always do!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_227_OBJECTIVE
Text: My friend Mason is putting out a distress signal. It's coming from Prison Island.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_228_OBJECTIVE
Text: The hunter zombies have overwhelmed our police force here. Just about every cop is a freaking zombie now! I need you to collect ammo, plus the explosive charges and get them to my partner, over at Omega Avenue. The plan was to blow up the towers and burn this place down.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_228_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I'm too old for this. Zombies! What next! Aliens?! You got some ammo and explosives? Nice!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_229_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need to get this ammo to survivors. I can see the light on the other side of the avenue. I carry, you shoot. Ok?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_229_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Woah...almost squashed your head. Though you were a zombie! 'I have been searching for survivors... Didn't find any...

Name: TID_MISSION_0_229_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Let's go and shoot some zombie butt!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_230_OBJECTIVE
Text: I need to stay here, but my friend on the other side of the street needs better protection. Could you get him some metal? No.. not the music, some scrap metal!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_230_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Omigosh! Who are you? Oh.. Kirkman sent you? No survivors there either? Well, thanks for the metal

Name: TID_MISSION_0_231_OBJECTIVE
Text: I found out that my family got into a car accident. I found the car, it's right over there, but they didn't survive the crash. Please,.. I don't want them coming back as zombies. Could you please burn the car for me? I just can't do it

Name: TID_MISSION_0_232_OBJECTIVE
Text: My mate from Omega island called. There has been a zombie outbreak and citizens are in danger. Could you do some investigating?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_232_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for coming. This place is a madhouse!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_233_OBJECTIVE
Text: I saw a weird looking zombie around here. I think he has escaped from the L.A.R.P.U. factory nearby

Name: TID_MISSION_0_233_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You are truly a hero. Drinks on a house!

Name: TID_MISSION_0_234_OBJECTIVE
Text: Labycore has finally infiltrated Omega Island Harbor. They have some new tech there cleaning the streets. They will kill all the zombies but also all the survivors. Could you stop them?

Name: TID_MISSION_0_234_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You truly are hero of Dawnbreak.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_235_OBJECTIVE
Text: It was huge... it came with that Swarmbot. It, a group of scientists and robots, went looking for something from the wetlands. There was some hole in the ground... Im' going back to hiding

Name: TID_MISSION_0_235_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? Broken sentry bot and lava on the ground...That's so wierd.

Name: TID_MISSION_0_236_OBJECTIVE
Text: I stumbled upon this building in my travels. It's full of serious weirdness.. zombie monsters, pizza place full of brawlers, and what looks like a mafia wet room

Name: TID_MISSION_0_236_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh..by the daily tentacle! Wierd stuff! Thanks for cleening the building. I might be moving in...
